state.seed_assertion: ICO consultation is not required if a DPIA identified high risk but mitigating measures have reduced it to no longer be high.

sentences.1: ICO consultation is not required if a DPIA identified high risk but mitigating measures have reduced it to no longer be high.
sentences.2: If your DPIA identified a high risk but you have done things to reduce the risk so it is no longer high, you need not consult us.
sentences.3: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.4: We will write to you to within 10 days to let you know if we have accepted your DPIA for prior consultation.
sentences.5: If you have decided to accept a high risk, either because it is not possible to mitigate or because the costs of mitigation are too high, you must consult the ICO before you go ahead with the processing.
sentences.6: Harm does not have to be inevitable to qualify as high risk;
sentences.7: Harm does not have to be inevitable to qualify as a risk or a high risk.
sentences.8: If we have more significant concerns, we may impose a limitation or ban on your intended processing.
sentences.9: contact details of your DPO (if you have one);
sentences.10: You may not have to carry out a DPIA if: You are processing on the basis of legal obligation or public task.
sentences.11: you have a clear statutory basis for the processing
sentences.12: Mitigating measures should include the source of each identified risk and options for reducing that risk such as limiting data collection, reducing processing scope, reducing retention periods, improving security, staff training, anonymisation, pseudonymisation, and data-sharing agreements.
